purpose: Interdisciplinary framework for evaluating autonomous automation and auto-engineering work without authorizing autonomous external action.

classes.title: Foundations of Autonomous Automation Architectures
classes.academic_focus: Formal definition of autonomous systems, event-driven architecture theory, state machine modeling, and feedback control loops including PID controllers and decentralized consensus algorithms.
classes.occupational_application: Designing enterprise-grade self-healing microservices and unattended operational pipelines.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Bridges computer science control theory with industrial systems engineering.

classes.title: Auto-Engineering Systems & Cyber-Physical Integration
classes.academic_focus: Mechatronic kinematics, embedded real-time operating systems, and hardware-in-the-loop simulation models.
classes.occupational_application: Developing physical-digital twin systems for smart manufacturing and robotics.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Synthesizes mechanical engineering, electrical systems, and software engineering.

classes.title: Generative Auto-Design & Topological Optimization
classes.academic_focus: Algorithmic spatial generation, finite element analysis automation, evolutionary algorithms, and generative adversarial networks for physical and digital form factors.
classes.occupational_application: Automated CAD model generation, structural weight reduction, and architectural layout synthesis.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Combines computational geometry, material science, and industrial design.

classes.title: Auto-Computational Software & Runtime Synthesis
classes.academic_focus: Program synthesis, metamorphic testing, automated refactoring, and just-in-time compiler optimization theory.
classes.occupational_application: Writing, testing, and deploying production codebases through autonomous agentic loops.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Merges compiler design, software verification, and automated reasoning.

classes.title: Advanced Computer Science for Autonomous Systems
classes.academic_focus: Distributed consensus protocols, graph theory for network topology, asynchronous concurrency, and memory-safe systems programming.
classes.occupational_application: Scaling fault-tolerant, high-throughput distributed architectures that operate without human intervention.

classes.title: Algorithmic Prompt Engineering & Meta-Cognitive Prompting
classes.academic_focus: Zero-shot and few-shot token optimization, chain-of-thought formalization, semantic constraint parsing, and programmatic prompt generation frameworks.
classes.occupational_application: Structuring deterministic, programmatic interfaces for large language models to reliably execute complex multi-step workflows.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Intersections of artificial intelligence, cognitive science, and computer science.

classes.title: Predictive Data Analytics & Real-Time Telemetry
classes.academic_focus: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection via unsupervised learning, streaming data pipelines, and statistical process control.
classes.occupational_application: Predicting system failures before they occur and dynamically scaling resources based on real-time ingestion metrics.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Data science, statistics, and systems operations.

classes.title: Computational Linguistics & Syntax-Driven Parsing
classes.academic_focus: Formal grammars, Chomsky hierarchy, dependency parsing, tokenization algorithms, and transformer attention mechanism mathematics.
classes.occupational_application: Building robust natural language parsers that translate human intent into executable code scripts or system commands.

classes.title: Language Arts, Semantics, and Pragmatic Intent Modeling
classes.academic_focus: Pragmatics, discourse analysis, semiotics, stylistic tone matching, and rhetorical structures in machine-generated communication.
classes.occupational_application: Ensuring autonomous agents communicate with human stakeholders with exact context, clarity, and situational appropriateness.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Humanities, philosophy of language, and human-computer interaction.

classes.title: Cross-Disciplinary Coordination & Systems Interoperability
classes.academic_focus: Ontological modeling, semantic web standards, API schema translation, and universal middleware protocols.
classes.occupational_application: Unifying disparate enterprise software stacks into a single, cohesive autonomous ecosystem.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Systems engineering, enterprise architecture, and information science.

classes.title: Occupational Integration & Enterprise Workflow Automation
classes.academic_focus: Business process management automation, robotic process automation scalability, and organizational change management frameworks.
classes.occupational_application: Replacing legacy manual workflows with autonomous digital labor pipelines across corporate departments.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Operations research, business administration, and workflow engineering.

classes.title: Academic Rigor, Formal Verification, and Theoretical Proofs
classes.academic_focus: Hoare logic, model checking, theorem proving, and mathematical guarantees of system correctness under all possible states.
classes.occupational_application: Certifying safety-critical autonomous systems against catastrophic failure.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Mathematical logic and formal software verification.

classes.title: Autonomous Governance, Safety, and Ethics
classes.academic_focus: Algorithmic bias mitigation, alignment theory, fail-safe tripwires, regulatory compliance, and audit trail immutability.
classes.occupational_application: Implementing guardrails and transparent oversight mechanisms for fully autonomous enterprise environments.

classes.title: Self-Optimizing Feedback Loops & Machine Learning Integration
classes.academic_focus: Reinforcement learning from human and AI feedback, online learning algorithms, hyperparameter auto-tuning, and neural architecture search.
classes.occupational_application: Creating software and systems that continuously improve performance, speed, and accuracy over operational lifecycles.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Machine learning research and adaptive control theory.

classes.title: Capstone: End-to-End Autonomous Ecosystem Deployment
classes.academic_focus: System integration synthesis, holistic vulnerability assessment, disaster recovery simulation, and autonomous lifecycle management.
classes.occupational_application: Architecting, deploying, and maintaining a fully self-sustaining, multi-domain autonomous project from raw data ingestion to production execution.
classes.disciplinary_coordination: Grand synthesis of all preceding fourteen computational, engineering, analytical, and linguistic domains.
